site.fullName: Intelligent and Sustainable Information Systems Research Group
site.description: INSIST is a research community at Universitas Sriwijaya advancing intelligent and sustainable information systems through rigorous scholarship, interdisciplinary collaboration, and real-world impact.
site.address: Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Sriwijaya, Palembang, Indonesia
site.motto: Built with rigor. Designed for impact.
